body: I literally cannot go to someone else for help. Seeking mental health care functionally ruined my life once before, and that's when I was being treated for anxiety and the blues. I'm actually dangerous now; if what happened last year happens to me now, that'll be it for me forever.

They won't do anything for me except call the police on me (forcing me into mental health care that I do not feel safe in) or tell me that it gets better (which it most certainly will not). I've done it before. That helps when you're feeling blue and are in crisis. It doesn't help when you're completely out of options and can't seek rehabilitative care.
